name: LMS [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Exact product name]
oneLiner: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: One sentence — what the LMS does and for whom]
question: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: What does this project test or prove?]
problem: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: The problem the LMS solves — who struggles with what today]
targetUsers: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Who uses it — students, teachers, schools?]
whyItMatters: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Why this problem matters in your context]
exactRole: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Exactly what you built — solo or team, which parts are yours]
teamContributions: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Teammates and their parts, or 'Independent project']
research: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: What you researched or learned from before building]
validation: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Has anyone real used it? Testing done?]
proposedSolution: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: How the LMS works — main features and flow]
userWorkflow: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Step 1 of how a user moves through it]
systemArchitecture: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Stack and structure — frontend, backend, database, hosting]
methods: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Notable technical methods or patterns used]
businessValue: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: The commercial or institutional value if it succeeds]
contractsPolicy: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Terms, licensing, or institutional policy considerations]
dataPrivacy: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Student data is sensitive — what does the LMS store, and how is it protected?]
risks: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Main risks — e.g. student-data exposure, grading errors]
humanApprovalPoints: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Which decisions stay with teachers/admins rather than the system?]

completedWork.text: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: What is actually built and working]

evidence.text: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Repository URL (public or private?) and live site URL]

results.text: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Honest current results — users, pilots, or 'not yet measured']

tradeoffs: [OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED: What you chose to give up and why]
